Name: Punon
ModernLocation: Unknown; traditionally associated with Faynan, Jordan
Description: One of the stations on Israel's wilderness journey, named in the Numbers 33 itinerary. A mining region of the Arabah, later known for its copper works. No further detail is recorded beyond the journey account.
BiblicalSignificance: The wilderness stations trace the route God led Israel from Egypt to the Plains of Moab.
